nodes.label: Egregore OpenCode Adapter
nodes.rationale: Egregore was originally designed for Claude Code's slash-command patterns; OpenCode lacks native /reflect, /handoff, /quest, so the adapter maps them onto OpenCode's /ask prefix convention ('Reflect:', 'Handoff:', 'Quest:') plus git commits — making AI memory portable across runtimes so mixed teams share one memory repo.

nodes.label: Egregore Command Mapping
nodes.rationale: Compatibility table translating each Egregore intent (reflect, handoff, quest, activity, save) into an OpenCode-equivalent invocation; quest IDs are kept portable across both runtimes as long as both users point at the same EGREGORE_MEMORY_REPO.
